test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the wrongly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Beneficiel'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The wrongly spelled word here is **"Beneficiel".**
 
• The correct spelling for this word is** "Beneficial".**
 
• **"Beneficial"** refers to something that has a positive effect or promotes wellbeing. (लाभदायक)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Beneficial'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss all the words:
 
 
• **Benign: **This term is used to describe something that is harmless or not dangerous. (अहानिकर)
 
• **Besiege: **To besiege means to surround a place, especially with an army, to try to take control of it. (घेरा डालना)
 
• **Bifurcate: **This term means to divide into two branches or forks.(दो भागों में विभाजित करना)

The correct answer is 'Option 1'.</
